Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.http

Interface GeoServerHttpClient

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Closeable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ApacheHttpClient
public interface GeoServerHttpClient extends Closeable
Abstraction for HTTP communication with GeoServer REST API.

Implementations are responsible for:

  • Authentication (Basic Auth)
  • Connection/timeout management
  • Request/response logging

All methods return GeoServerResponse regardless of HTTP status code. Error handling (status code → exception mapping) is delegated to the caller (typically AbstractManager).

    • getBinary

      GeoServerResponse getBinary(String path, String accept)
      Performs a GET request and returns the raw binary response body.

      For 2xx responses the returned GeoServerResponse carries binary data via GeoServerResponse.getBinaryBody(). For non-2xx responses the text body is preserved in GeoServerResponse.getBody() for error-message extraction.

      Parameters:
      path - relative path (e.g., "/rest/workspaces/sf/datastores/mystore/file.shp")
      accept - Accept header value (e.g., "application/zip")
      Returns:
      raw HTTP response
